remarks_1999: Whitney Archive record lost. Abiquiú Notebooks notes inscription 2. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 12, 16. O'Keeffe wrote: "There are three paintings of the *Black Spot*. I never knew where the idea came from or what it says. They are shapes that were clearly in my mind –– so I put them down" (*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 15). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Black Spot, No. I

description: A black rectangular shape rises diagonally through this abstract composition. It rests inside a longer, slender turquoise form that echoes the black shape's diagonality. In the background, bulbous forms in shades of blue, green, pink, and yellow frame the central forms.
title: Black Spot No. I
